t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are different coloured gnomes which correspond with different coloured baskets and woods which each have different numbers of mushrooms. Learn to recognise the colour with the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: There are 6 different coloured gnomes which each correspond to a different number of mushrooms. I think this number differs depending on whether they appear on the left side of the screen or the right side of the screen. I think that the yellow and green coloured gnomes are worth more if they appear on the left side of the screen and the purple and pink gnomes are worth more if they appear on the right side. I also think each of the gnomes matches with a specific coloured basket and wood. I was trying to count the pattern of the basket appearances before my time was up, so I wasn't certain.
